# TestDZ — GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow the repository-wide instructions in `AGENTS.md` and the specialist roles/workflow in `docs/ENGINEERING_PLAYBOOK.md`. For the affected area, also read `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` and `docs/MASTER_BLUEPRINT.md`.

Preserve TestDZ product rules, architecture, security boundaries, RTL/design identity, and existing behavior. Inspect before editing. Never invent test results or claim unperformed verification. Resolve documentation conflicts using the latest explicit owner decision; otherwise ask before consequential changes. Do not perform destructive, production, merge, or deployment actions without explicit authorization.
